pages.text: Four $(l)primordial$() charms, made at the $(l)primordial altar$() from law charms and the Sin Lords' materials.$(br2)$(l)Recipes$(): carried only by the Sin Lords. In each world, $(l)four$() of the six lords other than Pride each carry one (which four depends on the world seed), and always drop it; the other two carry the Seven Sins and the World Core.$(br2)Every primordial charm: luck +80.

Main: Law of Arms$(br)+ Law of Arcana, Seething Copper Heart x2, Greed Gold Marrow x2, Origin Ingot x2, Truth Essence, Primordial Gem Powder x2, Volatile Core x2$(br2)Attack +150%, non-physical +150%, ignores all armor and resistance; each physical hit echoes as 50% magic.

Main: Law of the Gale$(br)+ Law of the Tailwind, Beguiling Crystal Tear x2, Stasis Crystal Marrow x2, Origin Ingot x2, Truth Essence, Primordial Gem Powder x2, Starlit Silk, Etched Bone$(br2)Attack speed, draw speed and projectile damage +150%; ignores invulnerability, homing, free arrows; what you hit freezes for a second.

Main: Unyielding Body$(br)+ Greed Gold Marrow x2, Stasis Crystal Marrow x2, Netherite Ingot x2, Origin Ingot x2, Truth Essence, Primordial Gem Powder x2, Runic Flesh, Molten Gel$(br2)Physical damage -85%, armor +10, no knockback; no single physical hit takes over 25% of your max health.

Main: Arcane Harmony$(br)+ Devouring Core x2, Mimic Mirror Crystal x2, End Crystal x2, Origin Ingot x2, Truth Essence, Primordial Gem Powder x2, Spirit Tear Crystal, Phase Pearl$(br2)Non-physical damage -85%, immune to harmful effects; 30% of non-physical damage taken is reflected as magic.
